narrative.intro: Clark Construction Group obligated $495M in federal contracts in FY2026 to date. Clark Construction Group won 17 awards so far, with an average award size of $29.1M, and obligations are up 0.6% year over year. The Department of Defense is the largest buyer, obligating $415M, followed by the General Services Administration at $76.9M. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is the largest NAICS market for Clark Construction Group at $316M, followed by Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction at $145M and Site Preparation Contractors at $33.7M. Historical federal obligations for Clark Construction Group show year-to-year movement: FY21 $167M, FY22 $178M, FY23 $603M, FY24 $1.6B, FY25 $492M, FY26 $495M. Award totals and obligations cited here are contract obligations, except where tables list award-value totals as total contract values. Current-year totals are partial, reflecting fiscal year to date results.

sections.heading: Who are the biggest federal buyers for Clark Construction Group?
sections.body: The Department of Defense is the biggest buyer, obligating $415M to Clark Construction Group. The General Services Administration is the next-largest buyer at $76.9M. The Smithsonian Institution obligated $1.6M, the Department of Justice obligated $1.2M, the Department of Health and Human Services obligated $953K, and the Department of Homeland Security obligated $10K.

sections.heading: What services and markets does Clark Construction Group supply to the government?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction is Clark Construction Group's largest market at $316M. Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction accounts for $145M and Site Preparation Contractors accounts for $33.7M. These NAICS markets represent the principal areas where Clark Construction Group receives federal obligations in FY2026 to date.

Historical obligations include FY21 $167M, FY22 $178M, FY23 $603M, FY24 $1.6B, and FY25 $492M.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Clark Construction Group?
faq.a: The Department of Defense is the top buyer from Clark Construction Group at $415M. The General Services Administration follows at $76.9M. Other buying agencies include the Smithsonian Institution at $1.6M, the Department of Justice at $1.2M, the Department of Health and Human Services at $953K, and the Department of Homeland Security at $10K.

faq.q: What does Clark Construction Group sell to the government?
faq.a: Clark Construction Group sells construction-related services to the government, led by Commercial and Institutional Building Construction at $316M. Clark Construction Group also sells Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction services at $145M and Site Preparation Contractors services at $33.7M.
